name: Reflect
definition: Single-target ranged hits from more than 1 tile away bounce back to the attacker. Melee, area and Chain hits land.

name: Dive
definition: Flies straight at you, giving each unit it passes Push 1 to its right. Strikes if it lands beside you.

name: Flying
definition: Moves over Bramble and Ice Pillars. Ignores traps, ground and Collision damage. Push, Pull and Wind still move it.

name: Bramble
definition: Blocks movement, not sight, for 3 enemy turns. A unit forced into it takes 2 damage and Bleed 1.

name: Lob Slag
definition: Marks your tile and the 4 around it. On its next turn, they take the shown damage and become Fire.

name: Charge
definition: Gains Charge each use. At 3, its next intent is Arc Burst: lightning jumping between nearby units. Shock removes 1.

name: Mirror
definition: Copies your last damaging card at base damage, without its effects. The copy is fixed when declared.

name: Icefall
definition: Marks 3 tiles across your tile. Next turn they take the shown damage; empty ones become Ice Pillars.

name: Wind
definition: After each of the next 2 enemy turns, Push every unit 1 tile downwind. Anchored units and bosses are immune.

name: Tether
definition: Every unit between two aligned Arc Thralls takes the shown damage and Shock. Terrain between them stops it.

name: Veiled
definition: You can target it only from an adjacent tile. Untargeted hits, like Area Attacks and Chain, still land.

name: Burrow
definition: Burrows and marks your tile; Erupt comes next. Burrowed, it can't be targeted or moved, but Area Attacks hit it.

name: Erupt
definition: Emerges at the mark, hitting and displacing its occupant. Neighbors get Push 1. Leaves Rubble; gains Expose 2.

name: Bursts
definition: When it dies, it deals the shown damage to every unit in the 8 tiles around it, then leaves Fire.

name: Shape Ground
definition: Place the shown ground on the shown tiles. A tile holds Rubble plus one other ground.

name: Fire
definition: A unit that enters takes 2 damage. One that starts its turn here takes 3.

name: Ice
definition: A unit that enters or starts its turn here is Chilled until it leaves.

name: Electrified
definition: A Lightning hit that touches it spreads to every foe on connected Electrified tiles. Chain relays through it.

name: Rubble
definition: Costs 2 movement to leave.

name: Chilled
definition: Takes 2 more damage from attacks. An Ice attack Freezes it and Expends the Ice beneath.

name: Detonate
definition: Expend the chosen Fire, or the shown ground. Hit everyone on those tiles and next to them once, including you.

name: Expend
definition: Remove the shown ground from its tile to power the listed effect.

name: Relocate Ground
definition: Move one ground tile to another open tile.

name: Melee
definition: Deal that much damage to an adjacent target, or one within the shown Range.

name: Ranged
definition: Deal that much damage to a target within Range and line of sight.

name: Pierce
definition: This damage ignores Block and Stoneskin.

name: Move
definition: Walk up to that many tiles around obstacles, triggering ground and traps you enter. Pick your own tile to stay.

name: Retreat
definition: Moves up to that many tiles away from its target.

name: Blink
definition: Teleport to a visible open tile within that many tiles, ignoring anything between. Pick your own tile to stay.

name: Range
definition: Maximum distance in tiles, counted without diagonals.

name: Block
definition: Absorbs damage before Health. Lost at the start of its holder's next turn.

name: Stoneskin
definition: Absorbs damage after Block. Lasts until used up or combat ends.

name: Heal
definition: Restore that much Health, up to the maximum.

name: Draw
definition: Draw that many cards. Your hand holds at most 7.

name: Card Play
definition: Playing a card spends 1. Refills each turn. Killing an enemy on your turn grants 1 more, except summons.

name: Flurry
definition: Repeat this card once per Card Play left, spending them all, on the same target. Pay its Time once.

name: Follow-up
definition: If you already played a card this turn: gain the listed bonus.

name: Empower
definition: Pay the listed extra cost when you play this card to gain the listed bonus. Charge it with the seal on the card's corner.

name: Stagger
definition: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time. Dragons take half. At most 6 per enemy each turn.

name: Time
definition: Cards cost Time; the more you spend, the later your next turn. Playing under 2 cards adds Wait.

name: Illusion
definition: Create a decoy with that much Health. Enemies attack it when it's at least as close as you.

name: Light
definition: Reveals tiles within its radius through the Umbra for the shown number of your turns.

name: Vision
definition: Widen your sight radius by that much for the shown turns. It creates no Light.

name: Truesight
definition: For the shown turns, every enemy counts as visible: you see its intent and can target it.

name: Dispel Umbra
definition: Lower the Umbra by that many stages for the rest of this combat.

name: Eclipse
definition: The darkest Umbra stage: you see only 1 tile around you. Light still reveals; Dispel Umbra lowers it.

name: Bleed
definition: Before each move or attack, it takes damage equal to its Bleed. Clears when its turn ends.

name: Expose
definition: The next attack that damages it deals that much more damage. Then Expose ends.

name: Sunder
definition: Before damage, remove up to that much Block, then Stoneskin, from the target.

name: Exhaust
definition: After use, this card leaves your deck until combat ends.

name: Consume
definition: After use, this item is gone for the rest of the run.

name: Retaliate
definition: Until your next turn, each enemy that hits you up close takes that much damage and the listed effects.

name: Quicken
definition: Your next card this turn costs that much less Time, minimum 1. Unused Quicken ends with your turn.

name: Rite
definition: Its effect lasts for the rest of this combat. Exhaust.

name: Next Attack
definition: Your next attack on a later card this turn gets the shown bonus. Unused bonuses end with your turn.

name: Swap
definition: Trade places with a visible one-tile enemy or your illusion. Both trigger the ground where they land.

name: Petrify
definition: Skips its next turn, still paying its Time. Gains the shown Block, kept through that turn. Dragons are immune.

name: Cleanse
definition: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.

name: Skate
definition: This turn, stepping onto Ice costs no movement, and Ice doesn't make you Chilled.

name: Anchored
definition: Push, Pull and Wind don't move it or cause a Collision. Yours lasts until your next turn.

name: Fireproof
definition: This turn, Fire ground doesn't damage you.

name: Convert Ground
definition: Turn the chosen ground tile, and its connected tiles when shown, into another ground. Hit each enemy on them.

name: Discharge
definition: Remove a connected Electrified network. Hit each enemy on it or next to it once.

name: Sweeping Strike
definition: Hit every enemy you can see that meets the shown condition, within Range if shown. No target to choose.

name: Swap Illusion
definition: Swap with one of your visible illusions, anywhere unless a Range is shown.

name: Shatter Illusion
definition: Destroy one of your illusions in range. Hit each enemy next to it.

name: Freeze
definition: Skips its next turn. Takes triple damage from attacks until then.

name: Shock
definition: On its next turn, it can only Move or Blink.

name: Immobilize
definition: Can't Move, Blink or Swap during its next turn.

name: Chain
definition: Jump to a new target within that many tiles, repeating from each one. Electrified tiles relay the jump.

name: Push
definition: Move the target that many tiles straight away from the source. If blocked: Collision.

name: Pull
definition: Move the target that many tiles straight toward the source. If blocked before reaching it: Collision.

name: Collision
definition: A stopped Push or Pull deals 2 damage per lost tile to the target and to its blocker.

name: Health
definition: At 0 Health a unit is defeated or terrain breaks. Your Health carries over between rooms.

name: Health Cost
definition: Lose that much Health when the card finishes. Block and Stoneskin don't prevent it.

name: Area Attack
definition: Hits each foe on the pattern's red tiles, seen or unseen.

name: Lightning Strikes
definition: Strikes the marked tiles for the shown damage, then turns them Electrified, replacing its old field.

name: Summon
definition: Calls the shown enemy, up to a limit of living ones. Killing a summon grants no Card Play.

name: Raise Terrain
definition: Raises attackable terrain with the shown Health. It blocks movement; some kinds also block sight.

name: Terrain Burst
definition: Hits units around terrain pieces for the shown damage. Some uses destroy the terrain too.

name: Cinder Marks
definition: Marks the shown tiles. When it lands, they take the shown damage and become Fire.

name: Crownfire
definition: Detonate the Fire on its last Cinder Marks. Everyone caught is hit once, the dragon included.

name: Hollow Gale
definition: Strikes everywhere within 2 tiles of the dragon with Push 2, then erupts along its last Razor Dive path.

name: Crystal Mantle
definition: Each layer cancels 1 direct hit, then breaks. Ground damage, Bleed, Collision and traps bypass it.

name: Guard Ally
definition: Gives the shown Block to one or more enemies, sometimes including itself.

name: Heal Ally
definition: Restores the shown Health to a wounded enemy, possibly itself.

name: Last Eclipse
definition: Unprotected targets take the shown damage, then the Umbra becomes Eclipse for 2 turns. Light, Vision and Truesight protect you.

name: Radiance
definition: Cards and skills that counter the Umbra with Light, Vision, Truesight and Dispel Umbra.

name: Embers
definition: Earned from kills and victories. Spend them on wares and levels. Dying drops them; recover them next run.

name: The Run
definition: One attempt through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon. Ends at the last dragon, at defeat or by Embrace.

name: Map and Rooms
definition: Each section is a map of rooms. Pick a forward route through combat, Relic, Scavenger, Ember Hearth and other rooms.

name: Character
definition: The menu for your gear, magic, items and skills. Gear, magic and items form your deck.

name: Rewards
definition: After a combat, choose 1 of 3 magic cards, or skip to heal 3. Dragons and Guardians also give relics.

name: Relics
definition: Passive effects that last the whole run. Found in Relic rooms and won from dragons and Guardians.

name: Combat Board
definition: The 9×9 tile grid where combat happens.

name: Turn Clock
definition: Each unit has a next-turn time; the lowest acts next, and you win ties. Spending Time pushes yours later.

name: Health and Defenses
definition: Damage hits Block first, then Stoneskin, then Health. Pierce skips Block and Stoneskin.

name: Defiance
definition: Each charge turns lethal damage into 25% Health. You get 1 per 4 levels, refilled each run.

name: Targeting
definition: Targets must be visible and within Range. Ranged attacks also need line of sight; walls and outcrops block it.

name: Fatigue
definition: When you must draw from an empty draw pile, reshuffle your discard and lose 2 Health, +1 each time.

name: Traps
definition: Trigger once when entered or hit. They damage their tile and spread their element to the 4 tiles around.

name: The Umbra
definition: Darkness that limits your sight. Hidden enemies show no intent and can't be targeted, but Area Attacks still hit them.

name: Worldspines
definition: Attackable stone spires that block movement, not sight. Destroyed ones leave Rubble. Damage pulses out around them.

name: Fire
definition: Card element. Fire cards mostly place Fire ground and Detonate it.

name: Ice
definition: Card element. Ice cards place Ice ground, and an Ice attack Freezes a Chilled target.

name: Lightning
definition: Card element. Lightning cards place Electrified ground; a damaging Lightning attack spreads through it.

name: Air
definition: Card element. Air cards move units with Push and Pull, and move you.

name: Earth
definition: Card element. Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and grant Stoneskin.

name: Quick Wits
definition: Once per combat, discard a card to gain @icon(draw) 1. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Measured Breath
definition: At the end of your turn, bank 1 unused @icon(card_play) for your next turn. Wait still applies.

name: Ghost Stride
definition: Once per combat, activate to make your next free move a @icon(blink) of up to 2 tiles.

name: Discerning Eye
definition: Once between bosses, replace every card in a non-boss combat reward with new ones.

name: Rehearsed Escape
definition: Once per combat, activate to send your next non-item @icon(exhaust) card to your discard instead.

name: Makeshift Tool
definition: Once per combat, activate to send your next item to your discard instead of @icon(consume).

name: Carry the Guard
definition: Once per combat, activate while you have @icon(block): at the end of your turn, it becomes @icon(stoneskin).

name: Pain Remembers
definition: The first time each combat you lose @icon(health), the next non-item card put in your discard returns to your hand.

name: Sure-Footed
definition: Once per combat, take no damage from the first @icon(traps) that hits you.

name: Afterimage
definition: The first time each combat you @icon(blink), leave an @icon(illusion) 2 where you started.

name: Deferred Choice
definition: Skip a card reward to save 1 offered card. It replaces 1 card in your next non-boss card reward.

name: Salvager
definition: Once between bosses, recover the first equipment drop left uncollected after victory.

name: Borrowed Time
definition: The first card paid for with a banked @icon(card_play) each combat adds no @icon(time).

name: Last Reserve
definition: Once per combat, lethal @icon(fatigue) leaves you at @icon(health) 1.

name: Plunderer's Step
definition: The first time each combat a card's @icon(move) or @icon(blink) collects loot, gain 1 @icon(card_play).

name: Prismatic Instinct
definition: Once per combat, place any ground on a visible tile within @icon(range) 4. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Curator's Patience
definition: After choosing a relic, save 1 unchosen relic for your next relic offer.

name: Living Shadow
definition: Once per turn, when an @icon(illusion) is removed, return your latest non-item discard to hand.

name: True Bearing
definition: Before combat, choose an open starting tile within @icon(range) 2 of the entrance.

name: Encore
definition: Once per combat, return a non-item card from discard to your hand. Costs no @icon(card_play) or @icon(time).

name: Open Arsenal
definition: Equip any equipment in your trinket slot.

name: Confluence
definition: Once per combat, @icon(surface_relocate) 1 ground tile. Both tiles must be visible, within @icon(range) 4 of you and each other.

name: Last Door
definition: Once between bosses, a non-boss defeat returns you to the previous room at @icon(health) 1.

name: Long Dawn
definition: Temporary @icon(illuminate), @icon(vision) and @icon(truesight) you create last 1 more turn.

name: Sunpath
definition: Once per turn, when you @icon(move) or @icon(blink) 3+ tiles, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 for 2 turns on your path.

name: Witchlight
definition: Your @icon(illusion) give off @icon(illuminate) 1 while they last.

name: Dawnbrand
definition: Your first @icon(melee), @icon(ranged), @icon(push) or @icon(pull) hit each turn on an enemy in @icon(illuminate) applies @icon(expose) 1.

name: Afterglow
definition: When an @icon(illusion) is removed, leave @icon(illuminate) 1 for 2 turns on its tile.

name: Open Sky
definition: While you stand in @icon(illuminate), you have @icon(truesight).

name: Skill Point
definition: Earned as you level up. Spend them on skills in the Character menu.

name: Moltshards
definition: Won from your first dragon each run. Trade 1 for 250 Embers, or spend 1 to reset your skills.

name: Wait
definition: Each of your first 2 Card Plays left unused adds 5 Time to your next turn.

name: Turns
definition: Counts down at the start of each of your turns. The effect ends at 0; ∞ lasts all combat.

name: Ice Pillar
definition: Blocks movement and sight for 3 enemy turns. A unit forced into it takes 2 damage and shatters it.

name: Movement
definition: Tiles you can walk each turn without a card or Time. Refills at the start of your turn; base 2.

name: Item
definition: A card equipped in one of your 2 item slots. It joins your deck and has Consume.

name: Outcrop
definition: Attackable terrain that blocks movement. Worldspines and Powder Kegs count as Outcrops. Plain ones also block sight and leave Rubble.
